name: Support ticket triage
description: Summarise a customer message, classify it, and draft a reply.

steps.name: summarise
steps.instruction: Summarise the customer's problem in one or two sentences. Keep every fact that matters: order or invoice numbers, amounts, dates and what the customer asks for.

steps.name: classify
steps.instruction: Classify the problem. category is one of: billing, delivery, product, account, other. urgency is one of: low, normal, high. reason is one short sentence explaining the choice.
steps.criteria: category and urgency must be one of the allowed values.

steps.name: reply
steps.instruction: Write a short, polite reply to the customer that acknowledges the problem, states the next step, and gives no promise the input does not support.
steps.criteria: The reply must not promise refunds, dates or amounts that are not in the original message.
